caption:
𝗖𝗮𝗺𝗲𝗿𝗮 𝗻𝗮𝗵𝗶𝗻 𝗵𝗮𝗶? 𝗣𝗵𝗶𝗿 𝗯𝗵𝗶 𝘃𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗼 𝗯𝗮𝗻 𝘀𝗮𝗸𝘁𝗮 𝗵𝗮𝗶 🎥
Face dikhana zaroori nahi hai. Ye 4 tareeke try karo:
👉 Phone screen record karke samjhao
👉 Photos aur text ke saath voiceover
👉 Apne phone ke chhote clips + text
👉 Canva se simple slides banao
Pehle ek tareeka chuno, phir 3 video usi style mein banao.
Aap kaunsa tareeka try karoge? 1, 2, 3 ya 4? Comment mein batao 👇
